title: 分级 · 初中｜校园沟通与短文表达 · 60 句
description: 邀请、询问、失物说明、建议、学习计划与简短观点；从表达事实过渡到交代理由。

items.zh: 请带一件与你的家乡有关的小物品来交流会。
items.en: Please bring a small object connected with your hometown to the gathering.
answers: Please bring a small object connected with your hometown to the gathering.
items.notes: connected with：与……有关；gathering：交流聚会。

items.zh: 我们欢迎不会画画的人参加美术角。
items.en: People who cannot draw are welcome at our art corner.
answers: People who cannot draw are welcome at our art corner.
People who can't draw are welcome at our art corner.
items.notes: who 引导定语从句；be welcome：受欢迎。

items.zh: 如果你需要借乐器，请在报名时注明。
items.en: If you need to borrow an instrument, please say so when you sign up.
answers: If you need to borrow an instrument, please say so when you sign up.
items.notes: say so：说明这一点；sign up：报名。

items.zh: 这次活动的主题由参加者自己投票决定。
items.en: Participants will vote to choose the theme of this event.
answers: Participants will vote to choose the theme of this event.
items.notes: vote to choose：投票选择；participant：参加者。

items.zh: 比赛分两轮，第二轮只对第一轮的优胜者开放。
items.en: The contest has two rounds; only the first-round winners enter the second.
answers: The contest has two rounds; only the first-round winners enter the second.
items.notes: round：轮次；only 限定参赛资格。

items.zh: 学校开放日允许每名学生带两位家人。
items.en: Each pupil may bring two family members to the school open day.
answers: Each pupil may bring two family members to the school open day.
items.notes: each 后接单数；may 表示许可。

items.zh: 请尽量提前到场，以便有时间布置展台。
items.en: Try to arrive early enough to set up your display.
answers: Try to arrive early enough to set up your display.
items.notes: early enough to：足够早以便……；set up：布置。

items.zh: 作品可以匿名提交，但需要留下联系方式。
items.en: You may submit your work without a name, but contact details are required.
answers: You may submit your work without a name, but contact details are required.
items.notes: without a name：匿名；be required：被要求提供。

items.zh: 这次阅读分享没有固定书目。
items.en: There is no set reading list for this book discussion.
answers: There is no set reading list for this book discussion.
items.notes: set 在此是形容词，表示固定的。

items.zh: 原定的户外寻宝将改在体育馆里进行。
items.en: The planned outdoor treasure hunt will take place in the sports hall instead.
answers: The planned outdoor treasure hunt will take place in the sports hall instead.
items.notes: take place：举行；instead：改为。

items.zh: 我想参加交换活动，但不清楚是否符合年龄要求。
items.en: I would like to join the exchange but am unsure whether I meet the age requirement.
answers: I would like to join the exchange but am unsure whether I meet the age requirement.
items.notes: meet a requirement：符合要求；whether：是否。

items.zh: 能告诉我应把参赛照片发到哪里吗？
items.en: Could you tell me where to send my competition photograph?
answers: Could you tell me where to send my competition photograph?
items.notes: where to send：发到哪里；礼貌间接问法。

items.zh: 如果没有电脑，我可以手写报名表吗？
items.en: May I complete the form by hand if I have no computer?
answers: May I complete the form by hand if I have no computer?
items.notes: by hand：手写；if 说明申请另一方式的条件。

items.zh: 公告只写了开始时间，没有写结束时间。
items.en: The notice gives the starting time but leaves out the finishing time.
answers: The notice gives the starting time but leaves out the finishing time.
items.notes: leave out：遗漏；对照已给出与缺失的信息。

items.zh: 我们的小组缺一位朗读者，你有兴趣吗？
items.en: Our group needs someone to read aloud. Would you be interested?
answers: Our group needs someone to read aloud. Would you be interested?
items.notes: read aloud：朗读；would 表示礼貌邀请。

items.zh: 我应该自己准备材料，还是学校会提供？
items.en: Should I bring my own materials, or will the school supply them?
answers: Should I bring my own materials, or will the school supply them?
items.notes: or 连接两种安排；them 回指 materials。

items.zh: 请问奖品是给个人，还是给整个团队？
items.en: Are the prizes for individuals or for whole teams?
answers: Are the prizes for individuals or for whole teams?
items.notes: individual：个人；or 表示两种选择。

items.zh: 我想了解错过的那节课讲了什么。
items.en: I want to find out what was covered in the lesson I missed.
answers: I want to find out what was covered in the lesson I missed.
items.notes: be covered：被讲到；I missed 修饰 lesson。

items.zh: 你能推荐一本不太长的英文小说吗？
items.en: Could you recommend an English novel that is not too long?
answers: Could you recommend an English novel that is not too long?
Could you recommend an English novel that isn't too long?
items.notes: recommend：推荐；that 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 我找不到活动室，地图上也没有标出来。
items.en: I cannot find the activity room, and it is not marked on the map.
answers: I cannot find the activity room, and it is not marked on the map.
I can't find the activity room, and it isn't marked on the map.
I can't find the activity room, and it is not marked on the map.
I cannot find the activity room, and it isn't marked on the map.
items.notes: be marked on：标在……上。

items.zh: 我捡到一本写着姓名首字母的笔记本。
items.en: I found a notebook with someone's initials inside.
answers: I found a notebook with someone's initials inside.
items.notes: initials：姓名首字母；with 表示带有某信息。

items.zh: 书包里最容易辨认的东西是一把彩虹色雨伞。
items.en: The easiest thing to recognise in the bag is a rainbow-coloured umbrella.
answers: The easiest thing to recognise in the bag is a rainbow-coloured umbrella.
items.notes: the easiest thing to：最容易……的东西。

items.zh: 如果这是你的表，请描述一下表带。
items.en: If this is your watch, please describe its strap.
answers: If this is your watch, please describe its strap.
items.notes: describe：描述；strap：表带。

items.zh: 我最后一次用公交卡是在图书馆附近。
items.en: I last used my bus pass near the library.
answers: I last used my bus pass near the library.
items.notes: last 作副词表示最后一次；bus pass：乘车卡。

items.zh: 盒子外面没有姓名，所以我们暂时交给了老师。
items.en: The box had no name on it, so we left it with a teacher for now.
answers: The box had no name on it, so we left it with a teacher for now.
items.notes: leave something with someone：交给某人保管。

items.zh: 排练之后，讲台上多了一副眼镜。
items.en: A pair of glasses was left on the teacher's desk after rehearsal.
answers: A pair of glasses was left on the teacher's desk after rehearsal.
items.notes: a pair of 作主语时用 was；glasses：眼镜。

items.zh: 我把两份作业装进了错误的文件袋。
items.en: I put the two assignments into the wrong folders.
answers: I put the two assignments into the wrong folders.
items.notes: assignment：作业；wrong：错误的。

items.zh: 打印机把最后一段漏印了。
items.en: The printer left the final paragraph off the page.
answers: The printer left the final paragraph off the page.
items.notes: leave ... off：漏掉；paragraph：段落。

items.zh: 不是我不想回复，而是那条消息没发成功。
items.en: I meant to reply, but the message failed to send.
answers: I meant to reply, but the message failed to send.
items.notes: mean to do：打算做；fail to do：未能做成。

items.zh: 展示时间变短了，因此我们省去了最后一个例子。
items.en: The presentation time was shortened, so we left out our final example.
answers: The presentation time was shortened, so we left out our final example.
items.notes: be shortened：被缩短；so 引出后果。

items.zh: 与其在走廊排队，不如给不同班级安排不同时间。
items.en: Instead of queuing in the corridor, different classes could come at different times.
answers: Instead of queuing in the corridor, different classes could come at different times.
items.notes: instead of doing：用另一安排替代当前做法。

items.zh: 如果我们把说明画出来，低年级学生可能更容易懂。
items.en: Younger pupils might understand the instructions better if we illustrated them.
answers: Younger pupils might understand the instructions better if we illustrated them.
items.notes: if 与 might 表示建议可能产生的效果；illustrate：配图说明。

items.zh: 我建议每组留一名成员负责回答观众提问。
items.en: I suggest that each group leave one member to answer visitors' questions.
answers: I suggest that each group leave one member to answer visitors' questions.
items.notes: suggest that 后动词用原形；leave someone to do：留下某人做。

items.zh: 展品不必全部摆在同一个高度。
items.en: The exhibits need not all be displayed at the same height.
answers: The exhibits need not all be displayed at the same height.
The exhibits needn't all be displayed at the same height.
items.notes: need not all：不必全部；be displayed：被展示。

items.zh: 午休时间有限，我们可以先试最短的路线。
items.en: Since the lunch break is short, we could try the shortest route first.
answers: Since the lunch break is short, we could try the shortest route first.
items.notes: since 引出理由；could 表示建议。

items.zh: 两种想法可以保留，只要大家知道分别用于什么。
items.en: We can keep both ideas as long as everyone knows what each is for.
answers: We can keep both ideas as long as everyone knows what each is for.
items.notes: as long as：只要；each 指两种想法中的每一种。

items.zh: 音乐声能否调小一点，让正在讨论的人听得见彼此？
items.en: Could the music be quieter so people discussing the task can hear one another?
answers: Could the music be quieter so people discussing the task can hear one another?
items.notes: so 引出调整音量的目的；one another：彼此。

items.zh: 我们不妨先征求意见，再决定是否更换班徽。
items.en: Why not ask for opinions before deciding whether to change the class badge?
answers: Why not ask for opinions before deciding whether to change the class badge?
items.notes: why not + 动词原形：提出建议；whether：是否。

items.zh: 如果有人帮我写稿，我愿意负责活动开场。
items.en: I am willing to open the event if someone helps me write the script.
answers: I am willing to open the event if someone helps me write the script.
items.notes: if：如果；be willing to：愿意；script：稿件。

items.zh: 如果海报太拥挤，就把详细日程放到另一张纸上。
items.en: If the poster is crowded, put the detailed schedule on a separate sheet.
answers: If the poster is crowded, put the detailed schedule on a separate sheet.
items.notes: crowded：内容拥挤；separate sheet：单独的一张纸。

items.zh: 我给复习计划留了空档，好补上没完成的部分。
items.en: I left gaps in my revision plan to catch up on unfinished work.
answers: I left gaps in my revision plan to catch up on unfinished work.
items.notes: catch up on：补上；to 表示目的。

items.zh: 我先用自己的话解释规则，再对照课本检查。
items.en: I explain the rule in my own words before checking it against the textbook.
answers: I explain the rule in my own words before checking it against the textbook.
items.notes: in my own words：用自己的话；check against：对照检查。

items.zh: 每天的记录帮助我发现自己总在同一处出错。
items.en: My daily record helped me notice that I kept making the same error.
answers: My daily record helped me notice that I kept making the same error.
items.notes: keep doing：反复做；notice that：发现……。

items.zh: 背完单词以后，还需要知道它们在句子里怎么用。
items.en: After learning the words, I still need to know how they work in sentences.
answers: After learning the words, I still need to know how they work in sentences.
items.notes: how they work：它们如何使用；still 表示还需要。

items.zh: 我把错题按原因分类，而不是只按科目分类。
items.en: I group my mistakes by cause, not just by subject.
answers: I group my mistakes by cause, not just by subject.
items.notes: group ... by ...：按……分类；cause：原因。

items.zh: 这张表是用来发现变化的，并不是要求每天完成同样多的任务。
items.en: This chart is for spotting changes, not for demanding the same amount of work every day.
answers: This chart is for spotting changes, not for demanding the same amount of work every day.
items.notes: be for doing：用于做某事；两种用途形成对照。

items.zh: 我宁愿把一个问题弄懂，也不想匆忙看完十个答案。
items.en: I would rather understand one problem than rush through ten answers.
answers: I would rather understand one problem than rush through ten answers.
items.notes: would rather ... than ...；rush through：匆匆做完。

items.zh: 把手机留在另一个房间后，我更容易专心了。
items.en: Leaving my phone in another room made it easier to concentrate.
answers: Leaving my phone in another room made it easier to concentrate.
items.notes: made it easier to：使做某事更容易；动名词作主语。

items.zh: 这周我打算检查计划是否太紧，而不只是看有没有完成。
items.en: This week I will check whether my plan is too demanding, not just whether I finished it.
answers: This week I will check whether my plan is too demanding, not just whether I finished it.
items.notes: 两个 whether 从句区分计划合理性和完成情况。

items.zh: 我发现讲给别人听能暴露自己没弄懂的地方。
items.en: Explaining it to someone else reveals the parts I have not understood.
answers: Explaining it to someone else reveals the parts I have not understood.
Explaining it to someone else reveals the parts I haven't understood.
items.notes: reveal：暴露；定语从句限定尚未理解的部分。

items.zh: 谢谢你在我找词时耐心等着，没有替我把话说完。
items.en: Thank you for waiting while I searched for words instead of finishing my sentence for me.
answers: Thank you for waiting while I searched for words instead of finishing my sentence for me.
items.notes: thank you for doing；instead of 区分等待和代说。

items.zh: 这次展示让我明白，提问有时比马上给答案更有用。
items.en: The display taught me that asking questions can be more useful than giving immediate answers.
answers: The display taught me that asking questions can be more useful than giving immediate answers.
items.notes: more useful than：比……更有用；动名词作比较对象。

items.zh: 我感谢那些负责收拾、却没有站上舞台的同学。
items.en: I am grateful to the classmates who cleaned up without appearing on stage.
answers: I am grateful to the classmates who cleaned up without appearing on stage.
items.notes: be grateful to：感谢某人；who 限定感谢对象。

items.zh: 如果班级投票只允许一种意见，结果就没有多大意义。
items.en: A class vote means little if only one opinion is allowed.
answers: A class vote means little if only one opinion is allowed.
items.notes: mean little：意义不大；if 引出限制条件。

items.zh: 允许学生选择展示方式，可以让不同长处得到发挥。
items.en: Letting pupils choose how to present their work can bring out different strengths.
answers: Letting pupils choose how to present their work can bring out different strengths.
items.notes: bring out：发挥、显现；how to present：如何展示。

items.zh: 我不认为安静的同学一定没有想法。
items.en: I do not think quiet classmates necessarily lack ideas.
answers: I do not think quiet classmates necessarily lack ideas.
I don't think quiet classmates necessarily lack ideas.
items.notes: not ... necessarily：不一定；lack：缺少。

items.zh: 一次不理想的成绩可以提醒我调整方法，却不能说明我的全部能力。
items.en: A disappointing result can prompt a change of method without defining all my abilities.
answers: A disappointing result can prompt a change of method without defining all my abilities.
items.notes: prompt：促使；without 限定成绩能说明的范围。

items.zh: 班级规定如果配上理由，往往更容易被理解。
items.en: Class rules are often easier to understand when reasons are given.
answers: Class rules are often easier to understand when reasons are given.
items.notes: when 表示某种条件下；be given：被说明。

items.zh: 互相帮助不等于把自己的答案直接交给别人。
items.en: Helping one another is not the same as handing over our answers.
answers: Helping one another is not the same as handing over our answers.
Helping one another isn't the same as handing over our answers.
items.notes: not the same as：不等同于；hand over：直接交给。

items.zh: 我希望下次活动也能听见那些不常发言的人的声音。
items.en: I hope the next event also includes voices we do not often hear.
answers: I hope the next event also includes voices we do not often hear.
I hope the next event also includes voices we don't often hear.
items.notes: hope 后接从句；voices 在此代指意见。
